items.title: fix(ui): keep Secrets row actions inside narrow tables (#154586)
items.summary: fix(ui): keep Secrets row actions inside narrow tables (#154586) Closes #154446 ## What Problem This Solves Fixes clipped Secrets row actions in narrow Settings tables, including tablet-sized touch layouts. ## User Impact Operators can see and activate the complete actions button without resizing the window. The existing phone layout and 44px touch target remain intact; secret storage, values, access policy, and Gateway methods are unchanged. ## Why This Change Was Made The fixed-layout actions column reserved 44px but its cell also carried horizontal padding. Size that existing column for the button plus both padding tokens. The regression keeps only the two failing narrow mouse/touch cases; existing desktop/phone tests and direct browser controls cover the unaffected layouts. ## Evidence Current source base `502d4be3af70d92ffdcbe6dc10e4ad0b7c190483` and candidate `72b902d9e7f00bcc5796ec9889f97ba9bec3a854` were exercised through the actual Control UI and the existing mocked Gateway with synthetic secret metadata, not a live secret store. | Viewport/input | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | 1000px mouse | Button ends 10px beyond the table | Button ends 16px inside the table | | 1000px touch | Button ends 16px beyond the table | Button ends 16px inside; target remains 44×44px | | 1440px desktop / 390px phone | Contained controls | Contained controls; phone layout unchanged | Enter opened the actions menu in every candidate browser case. [Inspected current before/after screenshots](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/154586#issuecomment-5761946653) are embedded in that comment and were verified rendering in the actual PR page. The same exact image pair was also delivered in the originating chat. - Negative control: temporarily restoring the original 44px width made both focused regression cases fail (`943 > 933` and `949 > 933`). The fix was restored immediately afterward. - Focused Secrets E2E suite: **9/9 passed**, including the real production UI bundle build. File test time: **12.777s**; new cases: **491ms + 711ms = 1.202s**. Vitest reported **21.40s**, **23.19s** command wall time, including a **6.94s** UI build. - Scoped type-aware lint, stylesheet lint, and formatting checks passed. No project-wide suite was run. The earlier contributor CI run on `a2f9253a3b44af0e727b75ef73c9077afc23e7b2` reported startup-corpus timeouts outside the UI files. That run is not claimed green or replayed here; applicable hosted CI for the new head remains the landing gate. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.summary: fix(test): release seeded stores before Gateway startup Startup began taking Doctor maintenance ownership in 3a46c0fee22, but real-Gateway fixtures still held parent-side agent database leases after seeding. Close the test instance's scoped session stores before launch, and close QA stores after stopped-state mutation before replacement. Keep production maintenance enforcement and test assertions unchanged. Linux bisect: c5cddb2da34 and 4078c72af83 pass; 0883394977d and 3a46c0fee22 fail with the parent lease refusal. The existing E2E tests cover both missing handoffs. Validation: 20 standalone command-palette passes; three complete 32-file, 62-test CI E2E passes; 236 owner/sibling tests; changed-file checks; formatting and whitespace checks; independent P2-clean review.

items.title: 北韓駭客組織WaterPlum利用假冒求職感染全球至少3萬臺裝置，竊取千萬美元加密貨幣
items.summary: 美國、日本、澳洲及德國政府9月18日發布聯合公告，揭露北韓駭客組織WaterPlum（又稱Contagious Interview）的攻擊活動。該組織的活動是由日本警方與FBI等單位調查後發現，自2025年12月至2026年7月間，至少感染全球100多國3萬臺裝置，主要鎖定網頁設計師、工程師及加密貨幣、區塊鏈與Web3專業人士，並從超過7,000個加密貨幣錢包竊取資金或憑證，至少已將1,071萬美元加密貨幣轉移至北韓。FBI與日本警方評估認為，WaterPlum及相關北韓IT人員，隸屬於北韓軍需工業部中央委員會第313總局。
